newsitem.title: UK: UK's Blair promises tight grip on economy.
newsitem.headline: UK's Blair promises tight grip on economy.

text.p: Prime Minister Tony Blair on Thursday promised to keep a tight grip on the British economy and not to impose excessive burdens on business.
Blair made the comments at a meeting in London with the board of Ford Motor Co, which had invited him to discuss his government's plans to boost skills and training.

"The new government is absolutely determined to keep a very tight grip on economic stability because that is a pre-condition to achieving economic success," Blair told the Ford directors at a central London hotel.
"We intend to run a very tight ship."
Blair said the new Labour government was determined to build a platform of economic stability before embarking on its promised reforms.
He said he would not impose "over-burdensome measures" on business but said it was a government priority to improve education and skills.
